description: Reviews an Umbraco package repo's dependencies: bot update PRs, security alerts and outdated packages. Sorts each by kind and drafts one action per item (merge, close, hold or bump), plus fixes to dependabot.yml. Acts only with a yes. Use for "go through the Dependabot PRs", "can I merge this bump", "what's out of date", or tidying dependencies.
